kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نقعنسس (form XIV)
# نَقْعَنْسِسُ (naqʕansisu) /naq.ʕan.si.su/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِقْعَنْسَسَ (iqʕansasa)
# نَقْعَنْسِسَ (naqʕansisa) /naq.ʕan.si.sa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْعَنْسَسَ (iqʕansasa)
# نَقْعَنْسِسْ (naqʕansis) /naq.ʕan.sis/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِقْعَنْسَسَ (iqʕansasa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
